bc910d85e Student Scheduling  - added ability to override the following reservation properties (for any reservation)    - reservation priority, must be used, can assign over limit, allow overlap (time conflicts)  - see the unitime.reservation.* application properties    - for instance set unitime.reservation.canOverLimit.group to true to allow students meeting a student group reservation to be enrolled over the course / configuration / class limits
95d08e6b3 Override Reservation - a special type of reservation has been created (named override) - override does not take any space (it appears as expired) - override reservation can be attached to one or more students (giving them the override), like individual reservation - override does not need to be used (unlike individual or group reservation)   - a student may choose (or can be given) an alternative enrollment that is not using the override - there are two types of overrides: allow time conflict and can assign over limit
10e5cc86e Course Timetabling: Distribution Preferences  - Added structure "One of Each"   - the distribution constraint is created for each combination of classes such that one class is taken from each line representing a class or a scheduling subpart   - for instance, if the constraint is put between three scheduling subparts, a constraint will be posted between  each combination of three classes, each from one of the three subparts   - if a constraint is put between a class and a scheduling subpart, there will be a binary constraint posted between the class and each of the classes of the scheduling subpart
67976759a Course Timetabling: Time Location  - added ability to return times in either 12-hour or 24-hour time format  - format the times using the GwtConstants.useAmPm constant
9f555cec5 IFS  - variable: domain computation can consider the current assignment Course Timetabling  - purge invalid values: avoid forward checking in group constraint  - group constraint: avoid forward check on variables with large domains (parameter ForwardCheck.MaxDomainSize, defaults to 1000)  - lectures with multiple rooms: for each time, limit the number of room combinations (parameter General.MaxRoomCombinations, defaults to 100)    - domain is dynamic (not cached) in this case, preferring rooms that are available for the given time (for which the room combinations are generated)
afc5404f1 Locking  - to overcome the concurrent modification issues caused by the new assignment model and the parallel approach, solution level reentrant read/write lock is introduced and used whenever an assignment (of the solution) is being changed  - solution lock is used whenever the solution is accessed from the UI (this replaces the previous synchronized(currentSolution) sections)
a296d3006 Application Properties  - register and use all (or most of) application properties through the ApplicationProperty enum    - this allows for an easy place to see all configuration properties, define their default values and short descriptions  - Application Configuration page modified to include all registered properties, including their defaults and descriptions
b942ab0da Student Scheduling  - format all names using the provided instructor and student formats
5c28ecb51 Database Solver Loaders  - clear assignment contexts after the model is loaded
6509789e4 CPSolver Update  - using the latest (snapshot) version of CPSolver 1.3  - this includes    - package change to org.cpsolver (was net.sf.cpsolver)    - new assignment model    - new multi-core solver capabilities
431679bbe Solver Database Loader / Saver  - set hibernate cache mode to ignore
8d4120c51 Code cleanup  - using svn blame to define (or extend) @author tags    - in case of multiple authors, the authors are ordered by their contribution (most contributing authors first)  - include 2013 and UniTime version 3.5 in the copyright message
4c4178ba1 Merging all the development that have been done on the dev_cluster branch back to the trunk (main development of UniTime 3.5)  - while still far from being complete, there are some very promising results  - the online student scheduling server can now be run in various modes    - within the web server (like in UniTime 3.4)    - on any of the machine within the cluster (either a web server or a remote solver server)    - on multiple machines at once       - either not holding any data (slow),       - having the data distributed along the cluster in a fully transactional manner,       - or with the data asynchronously replicated with one machine being the master (responsible for all the updates)  - lots of testing is needed  - other changes with the merge    - technology update (especially using Hibernate 4)    - possibility to use either       - asynchronously replicated EhCache cache,       - or synchronosly distributed / invalidated transactional Infinispan cache       as Hibernate L2 cache across the cluster)    - web server(s) and remote solver serves are now using JGroups to communicate with each other within a cluster
91a6b19f7 Student Accommodations  - Student Accommodations (administration): added page Student Accommodations where student accommodations / special needs can be managed (very much like with the Student Groups)  - Instructional Offering Detail, Class Detail, Examination Detail, Event Detail: Enrollments table shows student accommodations, if there are any (column Accommodation is only visible if there is at least one student with an accommodation)  - Instructional Offering Detail, Class Detail, Examination Detail: If there are any student accommodations, short overview table (accommodation name plus the number of students in the offering / class / exam) is also present at the bottom of the top most section
8d1e8e465 Date formatting  - to prevent concurrency issues (see bug JDK-6609686, http://bugs.sun.com/view_bug.do?bug_id=4264153) and to ease localization of date formats, most of the date formating is now done through the new Formats class  - instead of new DateFormat(pattern) use Formats.getDateFormat(pattern)
33e511d09 Enabled for Student Scheduling  - the "Display In Schedule Book" toggle (that can be set on a class) changed to (enabled for) "Student Scheduling" toggle    - the display in schedule book toggle had no meaning in UniTime, the setting was only recorded.    - now, if a class is disabled for student scheduling it appears in student scheduling (both batch and online) as if it had zero limit    - this means, that the class does not show up in the Course Finder dialog, and a student can get in the class only if he/she has an individual reservation for the class
b1b833865 Student Sectioning Status (No Batch option) - added ability to exclude some students from batch student scheduling   - students with sectioning status that has "No Batch" option checked are not loaded into the solver   - if these students already enrolled into some classes, they enrollments are counted towards the class, configuration, course, and reservation limits     - internally, the appropriate limits (if not unlimited) are decreased by the number of students that are enrolled in and not being scheduled by the solver (during the data load)   - this behavior is enabled by default, it can be switched off by setting the solver parameter Load.CheckForNoBatchStatus to false - added ability to set or reset student status (for the students that have been loaded into the solver) while a solution is being saved   - this is done by solver parameter Save.StudentSectioningStatusToSet, that can have the following parameters (e.g., defined as an enum):       N/A ... student status is kept as it is       Default ... student status is set to null (the status of a student is given by the default status on the academic session)       an abbreviation of the status (from Student Scheduling Status Types page) that is to be set to each student which has been loaded into the solver during the save   - if the parameter is not present (which is the default), student statuses are kept as they are during the save
b05bf9738 Course Timetabling, Student Scheduling  - if a class has variable limit, computation of the actual limit (based on the assigned room or rooms) was wrong    - it is the size of the smallest assigned room divided by the room ratio (not multiplied by -- the minimal room size is room ratio times class limit)
e98bc8bf7 Batch Student Scheduling: Ignore Student Conflicts Constraint  - it is now allowed for a student to be enrolled in conflicting classes (overlapping in time or back-to-back too far a part) if there is a required Ignore Student Conflicts between them  - such a conflict is completely ignored (e.g., unlike with classes that allow for overlap, it does not try to minimize the overlapping time)
bb3aa3a1d Student Scheduling: Linked Classes  - linked classes constraint was ignored when there were only two classes in the constraint    - the check was wrong, the constraint is to be used when there are at least two classes (not more than two classes) in the constraint
d6e6ed3f0 Course Timetabling, Examination Timetabling, Student Scheduling: Travel Times  - added ability to override distances computed using room coordinates by individual travel times set between pairs of rooms    - added database table travel_times to store individual travel times    - added Travel Times page under Courses > Input Data > Rooms (admin only)
ce74ed8eb Student Sectioning Reservations  - with the new features like by reservation only (on an offering) or allow overlaps (individual reservation) expired reservations can no longer disappear (not loaded)    - reservations have a n expired flag instead; expired reservations still work as ordinary reservations, except they do not reserve any empty space (i.e., they do not prevent other students to get into the offering / config / section)
f8703cdf4 (Batch) Student Sectioning Dashboard  - online student scheduling dashboard made available for batch sectioning solver    - similar functionality over data loaded in sectioning solver    - it is currently not possible to make changes (scheduling assistant has disabled enrollment)

content.text:
This confirms `getClassSuffix(course)` delegates to an external helper whose result can legitimately be `null` (e.g., when no custom class-name provider sets a suffix for that course), which is exactly what the fix commit guards against.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: dffa2a5298ca0540313fbae53788c9842eab2cdf

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of `StudentSectioningDatabaseLoader.java` with `git log --follow` and found the fix commit (`46eeb00df`) modifies a loop calling `section.setName(course.getUniqueId(), c.getClassSuffix(course))`. Searching the file's history for when this exact loop/line was first added led to commit `dffa2a529` ("Batch Student Scheduling: Section Names", June 20 2017), which introduced this code for the first time. I also checked the intervening commit `d42833f3e` that touched the same file, and confirmed it only changed unrelated logging/config-name code, never touching the `setName`/`getClassSuffix` loop.

**(2) Specific change:** `dffa2a529` added:
```java
for (CourseOffering course: io.getCourseOfferings())
    section.setName(course.getUniqueId(), c.getClassSuffix(course));
```
This unconditionally calls `section.setName(...)` with whatever `c.getClassSuffix(course)` returns, without checking for `null`. The fix commit `46eeb00df` adds exactly the missing null check (`if (suffix != null) section.setName(...)`), which is the direct undo of the bug.

**(3) Evidence:** `Class_.getClassSuffix(CourseOffering)` (JavaSource/org/unitime/timetable/model/Class_.java:1672) delegates to an external class-name helper and can return `null` when no course-dependent suffix is configured. Passing that `null` into `section.setName` propagated into the passivation/XML export layer, which cannot accept null text nodes — matching the fix commit's stated purpose ("this fixes an issue with the passivation / XML export (adding text to an XML document must not be null)"). Since this is the sole commit that ever introduced the unguarded call, and no other commit modified that specific code path before the fix, I'm confident this is the bug-introducing commit.
